title: Tools Diamond Heart
description: Diamond Heart Tools is a 16x16 texture pack that gives diamond tools a competitive look, mixing blue-cyan with crimson-red (ruby/heart style).
body: Diamond Heart Tools is a 16x16 Minecraft texture pack that redesigns diamond tools with a bold and competitive look. It combines the classic diamond blue-cyan color with a deep crimson-red tone, creating a unique visual identity inspired by hearts and rubies.
